title: Pulse Circuit: Overclock
description: High-voltage electromagnetic logic puzzle. Rotate and link conductive node relays, complete circuit traces from quantum cores to terminals, and trigger harmonic overclock surges before the meltdown timer trips.
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: Click circuit nodes to rotate 90° · Link all power traces to target terminals · Spacebar to pulse test · P to Pause
controls.mobile: Tap nodes to rotate connections and complete conductive pathway
